author.name: Semi Erendönmez
credits: Octatrack module and DSP56300 code by Semi Erendönmez
Effect ABI, schema and harness conventions: octabam (Sam Banks, MIT); the noise generator follows Analog BD's LCG idiom

presentation.label: RANDOM DROPOUTS
presentation.summary: The track drops out now and then, like a worn tape or a failing stream: to silence, a stuck loop or a crushed copy, and comes back.
presentation.overview: DROPOUT makes the track drop out at random moments (CHNC) for around LEN, each dropout fading in and out over EDGE. MODE says what it drops to: GAP silence, HOLD the last 1.5 to 21 ms looped like a stuck buffer, or CRSH the track held and reduced to 6 bits. DPTH sets how far it drops and TONE darkens it while it is out. Between dropouts the output is the input, bit for bit; CHNC 0 turns the dropouts off.
highlights: Random dropouts: how often (CHNC), how long (LEN), how hard they cut (EDGE)
Drops to silence, a stuck loop or a 6-bit crushed copy
TONE darkens the track while it is out
Untouched between dropouts, bit for bit
usage: On an audio track, hold FUNC and press FX1 (or FX2), turn LEVEL to DROPOUT and press YES.
On the main page CHNC sets how often the track drops out and LEN for how long; EDGE softens the cut. TONE darkens it.
FX1 SETUP holds MODE (GAP, HOLD, CRSH) and SIZE (the HOLD loop or the CRSH hold). Turn CHNC to 0 to stop the dropouts.

controls.name: CHNC
controls.doc: How often dropouts start: once in 20 s at 1 to every 60 ms at 127; 0 = never

controls.name: LEN
controls.doc: How long a dropout lasts, about 5 ms to 1 s (each one varies)

controls.name: DPTH
controls.doc: How far the track drops; 127 = all the way

controls.name: EDGE
controls.doc: How fast a dropout fades in and out, 0.1 ms to 50 ms

controls.name: TONE
controls.doc: Darkens the track while it drops out

controls.name: MODE
controls.doc: What the track drops to: silence, a stuck loop, a crushed copy

controls.name: SIZE
controls.doc: HOLD: the loop, 1.5 to 21 ms; CRSH: the hold, 2 to 33 samples

limitations: Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta) with an effect id of its own; the card builds' non-stock ids are all claimed but 0x07, which the draft holds as a placeholder.
Dropouts fall at random moments, not on steps: the effect follows no clock, tempo or trig. The random sequence starts from the same seed whenever the effect is loaded.
HOLD uses 2,048 words of the slot's buffer (an FX1 slot holds it); a loop never reaches back past what it recorded since it was loaded or since the last dropout ended.
HOLD's loop seam, EDGE 0's hard cut and CRSH's aliasing are deliberate glitches.
Not yet run in a built image, the ColdFire port or on a unit: only in fxhost (the vendored DSP56300 emulator alone).

storage.label: DSP program / table / buffer
storage.conditions: dsp_asm: 368 program words and one 387-word P table per core. 31 state words in each instance's own r7 block. 2,048 words of the allocator's Y buffer per instance (HOLD's 1,024 stereo frames).

processing.label: DSP instruction peak
processing.conditions: fxhost (dsp56kEmu alone), one instance, 16-frame calls at the dearest settings (HOLD, dropouts back to back, TONE 127): 2,494 instructions a call. Executed instructions, not chip cycles; not yet measured beside stock SPRING REV in dsp_host.

impact.conditions: One instance at its dearest settings.

cpu.rationale: No ColdFire code: a cloned effect descriptor; the stock pages publish the knobs.

dsp.rationale: 156 executed instructions a sample in fxhost, about half the 314 octabam's benchmark reports for stock SPRING REV; not measured under the same benchmark.

memory.rationale: 755 program-memory words on each DSP core (368 code, 387 table); 31 state words and 2,048 buffer words per instance.

tests.summary: fxhost only (the vendored dsp56kEmu with the module alone, no firmware): with CHNC 0, or DPTH and TONE 0, the output is the input bit for bit from garbage state and buffer and with trig splits; the dropouts' length and spacing follow LEN and CHNC; GAP's depth, HOLD's loop period, CRSH's 6-bit grid and hold, TONE and EDGE act as documented; HOLD never plays unrecorded memory; idle in every mode; nothing outside the audio, state, parameter and buffer words is written; 156 instructions a sample at the dearest settings. Not run in a built image, under the ColdFire port or on a unit.

license.declaration: Original DSP56300 code and tables by Semi Erendönmez, GPL-3.0-or-later. No Elektron firmware, extracted routines, tables, samples or dumps are included; no stock table is read.

access.location: Audio track FX1 or FX2 SETUP: DROPOUT in the effect chooser.
steps: Select an audio track with its TRACK key.
Hold FUNC and press FX1 (or FX2) to open its SETUP page.
Turn LEVEL to DROPOUT and press YES; MODE and SIZE appear on the SETUP page.
Press FX1 (or FX2) for the main page: CHNC, LEN, DPTH, EDGE and TONE.
